summary_md: **Double\_asa ([@double_asa](https://x.com/double_asa/status/2116787017707381157))** introduces his open **DSH to Figma**, which lets DeepSeek Harness read, create and edit native Figma layers, components and variables via a local mode that avoids paid official MCP quotas; he demos converting a dark UI to light and terminal-style variants in new frames and suggests uses for designers and developers ([Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma)).
